## Economic Events

### Inflation

| Event | Effect |
|------|--------|
| War | +50% prices |
| Famine | +100% food |
| Plague | +50% general |
| Prosperity | -10% prices |
| New trade | -25% goods |

### Market Fluctuations

| d6 | Market | Effect |
|---|---------|--------|
| 1 | Crash (-50%) |
| 2 | Down (-25%) |
| 3-4 | Stable |
| 5 | Up (+25%) |
| 6 | Boom (+50%) |
